thread:
maya: spotted an anomaly: console shows pairs of connections for same client_id on a bunch of EU routes for ~2m. logs show resume tokens present but backend created new session ids. snippet: ```INFO sse: resume_token_present=true prev_session=sed-29 new_session=sess-900 route=eu2```
sam: did billing double-count?
maya: invoices look fine. only per-route active_sessions inflated. alerts fired then auto-resolved. ops-bot: alert suppressed: sse.dup_conn_spike at 2026-03-24T07:18:40Z
li: this is resume vs fallback routing ambiguity. when a resume token lands on a shard that doesn't accept it, we currently allocate a fresh session and don't mark telemetry as "fallback". console treats new session ids as distinct connections.
sam: short fix: emit a low-cardinality metric sse.session_start{outcome:resume|new|fallback, region}. keep tenant out of tag set.
li: agree. also add a small sampled log when token present but new session created: include prev_shard and new_shard, client_ip (hashed), reason. sample at 1%.
maya: UI change: show a subtle "resumed" badge if token was presented within 20s of prior session; hover text: "Client reattached with resume token; routing fallback created new backend session. Billing unaffected"
sam: beware false positives for many clients behind NAT. put the badge behind a feature flag and canary to 5% tenants.
li: I'll open telemetry PR and sampling trace PR. maya can you do console badge PR. sam please update alert rule to ignore dup spikes when resume_ratio>0.4 in 1m window.
ops-bot: ticket created PLAT-9010 assigned to maya, li, sam
maya: thanks. rolling canary tomorrow 08:00 UTC for telemetry only. We'll monitor resume_ratio and false_positive_rate (FP = badge && distinct client_ip hashes).
